description: Notification of Prior Approval under Schedule 2, Part 1, Class AA Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) for the construction of one additional storey immediately above the topmost storey of the dwellinghouse, which would extend the existing roof height by 2.65m, raising the height of the dwellinghouse to 10.05m.
decision_conditions: <p style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245);">The development hereby granted must be completed within a period of 3 years starting with the date this prior approval is granted.</p><p style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245);">Reason: In accordance with Condition 3c of Class AA of Part 1 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) .</p>

<p><br></p><table width="100%" align="center" cellspacing="3" cellpadding="0" border="0" class="table table-bordered table-hover" data-object-name="AssessmentConditionsPhraseMap" style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); width: 1569px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); table-layout: fixed;"><tbody><tr id="row_154977" class="entry" style="background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245);"><td name="Detail" data-field-name="standard_phrase_paragraph" style="line-height: 1.42857; word-break: break-word;"><p style="text-align: justify;">All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing.<br></p><p style="text-align: justify;">REASON: To ensure a suitable external appearance in accordance with condition A.A.2(3)(ii) of Part 1 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</p></td></tr></tbody></table>

<p style="text-align: justify;">Prior to commencement, the developer must submit to the local planning authority for approval in writing a report for the management of the construction of the development, which sets out the proposed development hours of operation and how any adverse impact of noise, dust, vibration and traffic on adjoining owners or occupiers will be mitigated.<br></p><p style="text-align: justify;">Reason: To ensure effects are adequately managed to protect neighbouring amenity in accordance with condition 3(b) of Class AA of Part 1 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).<br></p><p><br style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245);"></p>

<table width="100%" align="center" cellspacing="3" cellpadding="0" border="0" class="table table-bordered table-hover" data-object-name="AssessmentConditionsPhraseMap" style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); width: 1569px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); table-layout: fixed;"><tbody><tr id="row_154978" class="entry" style="background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245);"><td name="Detail" data-field-name="standard_phrase_paragraph" style="line-height: 1.42857; word-break: break-word;"><p>The developer must notify the local planning authority of the completion of the development as soon as reasonably practicable after completion; and that notification must be in writing and include—(i) the name of the developer;(ii) the address of the dwellinghouse; and(iii) the date of completion.</p><p>Reason: In accordance with conditions 3(d) and 3(e) Class AA of Part 1 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended)</p></td></tr></tbody></table>
